video.description: Source video (.mp4). Motion, timing, camera, and scene come from this.
video.title: Video

images.description: Reference image(s) of people to place into the video (1-4 images).
images.title: Images

instruction_prompt.description: Describe who in the video to replace with whom from reference images. E.g. 'Replace the person in the source video with the woman from reference image 1. Keep lip sync, motion, audio, and camera from the source video.'
instruction_prompt.title: Instruction Prompt

turbo.description: Turbo mode: faster generation for slightly lower quality.
turbo.title: Turbo

target_fps.description: Target FPS: 'original' to match source, or '24'/'48'.

save_audio.description: Include audio from the source video in the output.
save_audio.title: Save Audio

ignore_audio.description: Ignore source audio during generation. If save_audio is true, audio is still saved.
ignore_audio.title: Ignore Audio

disable_safety_checker.description: Disable safety checker for generated videos.
disable_safety_checker.title: Disable Safety Checker
